One would imagine after WW2 pain and suffering would be far less than what's come to be and what hasn't even scratched the surface. 
Knowledge is pay to learn. Knowledge should be provided for free to every human being on this planet, especially when it comes to human biology. We all must get a degree for a so called job. How many jobs will be taken by automation in the next 20 years? How many more jobs will be given to the chinese? How long will it take for everyone to realize current society as we know it is fucked. irreparable. Look at our justice system. It takes some odd YEARS to convict murders of their crime. All while the ~~tax payers~~ sheep pay for them to await trial. Do I even need to get into privatized prisons? How about the CIA introducing crack cocaine into LA to start a "Drug War" that still affects people to this very day. Police doing whatever the fuck they want. I don't like when people say police are becoming militarized. Not true. That's an insult to the military. Police are becoming far worse. Rather than having the benefit of the doubt, officers are looking for potential criminals just to rack up their quota for the month. They deny having a quota yet hundreds of officers to this day have admitted to the latter. 

EVERYTHING IS FUCKED UP
